lead.body: The leaders of the US, China and Russia sit down together for the first time, on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Trump seeks nuclear arms cuts, Putin Ukraine terms, Xi strategic stability. No deal is expected.
lead.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet - a historic first

panels.body: The maker of Claude raises $81.3bn at $83 a share and starts trading on Nasdaq as ANT, valued near $1.5 trillion.
panels.headline: Anthropic debuts in biggest IPO in history

panels.body: A rare ground operation beyond the ceasefire line targets a tunnel, Israel says. Hamas calls it a flagrant breach.
panels.headline: Israeli tanks cross Gaza's Yellow Line

panels.body: A Russian official reports a new attack on the bridge struck a day earlier. Ukraine says it hit two Russian oil refineries.
panels.headline: Crimean Bridge attacked again

panels.body: Painted in 1890, in the artist's final months, it smashes the Van Gogh auction record after a row over its Nazi-era history.
panels.headline: Van Gogh sells for a record $190.4m

panels.body: NASA's farthest probe, launched in 1977, reaches a full light-day away: its signals now take 24 hours to travel home.
panels.headline: Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth

panels.body: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to lead the US House after their midterm wave, as the new Congress takes shape.
panels.headline: Jeffries set to be first Black House Speaker

ticker: GTA VI begins global rollout - Cyclone Akvan nears India - Prague protests for media freedom - Spain general strike
